title: Chen2017 – Single-flicker online SSVEP BCI dataset
description: A 32-channel EEG dataset from 12 healthy subjects performing a spatial navigation task using a single-flicker steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface. The dataset comprises two sessions per subject: a structured training session with calibration data recorded at 2048 Hz, and an online adaptive BCI game session recorded at 512 Hz. Data were acquired using a BioSemi ActiveTwo system with a spatially-coded paradigm where a single 15 Hz flickering stimulus was presented centrally while subjects attended to one of four cardinal direction targets.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded from 12 healthy subjects (7 female, 5 male; mean age 23.5 years, range 19-32) using a BioSemi ActiveTwo amplifier with 32 active electrodes in a biosemi32 montage and CMS/DRL reference. Training session data were acquired at 2048 Hz in XDF format with 2 runs of 100 trials per subject (50 trials per direction). Online session data were acquired at 512 Hz in MAT format with variable-length trials from approximately 16 game rounds per subject. All trials were approximately 3.5 seconds in duration.
